scripts.assets: mkdir -p dist/assets dist/images dist/images/chatbot-rag dist/scripts && cp assets/IDP.png dist/assets/IDP.png && cp subjects/poo/images/* dist/images/ && cp subjects/chatbot-rag/images/* dist/images/chatbot-rag/ && cp subjects/poo/scripts/* dist/scripts/
scripts.html:all: npm run html:poo && npm run html:poo:01 && npm run html:poo:11 && npm run html:poo:12 && npm run html:poo:13 && npm run html:chatbot-rag

scripts.html:poo:01: npm run assets && marp subjects/poo/lectures/01-introduction.md --html --output dist/html/poo-01-introduction.html
scripts.html:poo:11: npm run assets && marp subjects/poo/lectures/11-collections.md --html --output dist/html/poo-11-collections.html
scripts.html:poo:12: npm run assets && marp subjects/poo/lectures/12-file.md --html --output dist/html/poo-12-file.html
scripts.html:poo:13: npm run assets && marp subjects/poo/lectures/13-jdbc.md --html --output dist/html/poo-13-jdbc.html
scripts.html:chatbot-rag: npm run assets && marp subjects/chatbot-rag/chatbot-rag.md --html --output dist/html/chatbot-rag.html
